design_notes_sphere_rulers: Amen refraction: sole at the zero-point, unfolding into polarity only in descent (Amen-Men/Amenet-Menit at Binah; Amen-Ra/Amenet-Rait at Chesed).
Ausarian line: the three central-pillar sole rulers descend as family — Ausar (11) -> Heru (6); Auset seats at Yesod (9), where polarity begins.
Set is the only off-pillar sole ruler — the consortless isolate; capacitor of the tree.
two_slot_model: Each path carries a MARKER (sign/star/element/principle/planet — its signature) and a RULER (deity, or the principle Consciousness — its governor), independent slots. Venus marks Pillar of Harmony while Het-Heru rules it; Draco marks Coiled Power while Set (higher form) rules it.
ruler_structure_notes: Set: sole at Hod sphere + higher form on Coiled Power (ends at Hod) + lower form on Eye of Matter (starts at Hod) — every seat Hod-incident; the capacitor charges through his own terminal.
Divine Impulse co-rulers = its own endpoints: Atum (Chokmah/NSOROMA-ATUM) and Auset (Yesod). Only co-ruled path.
Ptah rules both skill-paths: Divine Skill & Command (central channel) and Applied Skill.
Canid psychopomps split the ways: Anubis (Conjoining & Separation), Wepwawet (Hunt & Catch).
Two Cancer paths carry two lunar powers: Taweret (Mobile Fortress), Khonsu (Hidden Influence).

Het-Heru rules twice: Fertile Dwelling, Pillar of Harmony. Nebt-Het's seat: Grasping Fate superseded by Iusaaset (pass 47); Nebt-Het pairs with Set at Hod (pass 47 Messengers' Directions). Ausar governs Regeneration.

Shu-Tefnut, the primal pair, hold The Dual Current and Flowing Revelation (both Chesed-incident); Shu matches the 3-year-old Divinities facet. Heru rules Solar Rising from his own sphere — marker (Sirius), ruler (Heru), and name (Solar Rising) all denote the heliacal rising.
Barque triad on paths (pass 9): Sia — Sequenced Images; Hu — Forceful Utterance; Heka — Flowing Revelation.
